description: This Java abstract class serves as a base controller for handling common web request operations, session management, and exception handling within a Spring MVC application for an e-commerce shop manager platform.

classes.name: AbstractController
classes.description: This abstract class provides general methods for session management, exception handling, and pagination support across web controllers in the shop management system.

methods.name: getSessionAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a session attribute value for a specified key, cast to the expected type.

methods.name: setSessionAttribute
methods.description: Sets a session attribute with the specified key and value.

methods.name: removeAttribute
methods.description: Removes a session attribute based on the provided key.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Fetches the Language object from the current request attributes.

methods.name: handleException
methods.description: Handles exceptions thrown during request processing, returning appropriate error views with details.

methods.name: createPaginaionData
methods.description: Creates a PaginationData object given page number and size.

methods.name: calculatePaginaionData
methods.description: Sets the total count of results in the PaginationData object and returns it.
